motivation: test whether the apparent high-register advantage is transferable by transposing low-register acoustic evidence upward
population: B_low + base prediction K3 + true K in {2,3}
low_register_definition: bottom tertile of original median_triplet_f0 on FIT only
tests: train/evaluate on the same low rows under each transposed representation
train on natural high-register FIT rows and evaluate on shifted low-register validation rows
interpretation_rule: if shifted low rows become more separable consistently, the high-register advantage is at least partly representation/frequency-location dependent
